description: Return the production time snapshot payload for one location or a list of locations.

countryCode.description: Optional ISO country hint for a single query.

anyOf.description: Optional ISO country hints aligned to the locations list.
Optional ISO country hints aligned to the locations list.

includeTransitions.description: Include last and next timezone transition details.

query.description: Single location query such as "Tokyo" or "Europe/London".
